// Extract form data from webhook payload
const formData = $input.first().json.body || $input.first().json;

return {
  json: {
    user_email: formData.user_email || '',
    company_name: formData.company_name || '',
    job_function: formData.job_function || '',
    strategic_question: formData.strategic_question || '',
    market_intelligence: formData.market_intelligence || '',
    strategic_context: formData.strategic_context || '',
    risk_factors: formData.risk_factors || '',
    competitive_landscape: formData.competitive_landscape || '',
    organizational_insights: formData.organizational_insights || '',
    user_ai_chip_rate: parseInt(formData.user_ai_chip_rate) || 50,
    user_crypto_rate: parseInt(formData.user_crypto_rate) || 50,
    user_ev_rate: parseInt(formData.user_ev_rate) || 50,
    user_supply_risk: parseInt(formData.user_supply_risk) || 50,
    user_regulatory: parseInt(formData.user_regulatory) || 50,
    user_consumer_rate: parseInt(formData.user_consumer_rate) || 50,
    pdf_file: formData.pdf_file || null,
    pdf_processed: formData.pdf_file ? true : false,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
  }
};
